invariants.name: A model run starts only at R4
The rung is the highest of the path rung, the law rung and both floors

category.equality: Two ladders are equal when their rung, their cause and their runs are equal, with each run compared by name, model contract and negative control.

abstraction.hides: The glob match of each changed path, the registry and profile reads at the diff base and in the tree, and the law rung of a plan block.
callersKnow: A docs-only diff that no model names gets R0 and starts no Java process.
Only R4 runs TLC. The manifest model runs first, then each model that a path or a tla law selects.
The proof.minRung floor only raises the rung.
abstraction.deletionTest: This change adds no code. Without the corrected text, the README opening and the changelog say that each change runs a TLA+ model check, and a reader expects TLC on a docs-only diff.

alternatives.name: Keep the opening claim of a model check on each change
alternatives.rejectedBecause: deriveLadder gives R0 or R1 to a diff that no model covers, and only R4 runs TLC.

alternatives.name: List each rung in the opening
alternatives.rejectedBecause: The opening stays short, and the change proof section of the README already lists the rungs.

omitted: The release version, the install examples and the changelog have no model state. The cli-version controls, the doc-facts controls and review examine them.
The model takes the glob match and the registry parse as true observations. The rl-rung control examines them.

bounds: Two models, seven path kinds, a base registry that can be absent, and the floors R0, R1 and R4 on each side.
Four law kinds: none, a prop law on a read-only cap, another prop law and a tla law that selects the second model.
A diff of one or two path kinds, and each order of the derive, start, judge and admit steps.

negative.defect: A rung rule that drops the fail-closed guard gives a rung to a guard file that no model covers, so a guard change merges with no model run.

limits: The rung of this change is R1, so no TLC run checks it. The finite model and its claims stay as the last R4 run left them.
The model does not check the words of the README, the changelog or the install docs. Review, the doc-facts controls and the STE gates examine them.
The owner signs the tag v0.4.0 after the merge. The release workflow verifies that signature, and this proof does not.
Exact-head CI, review, Shipping and every ordinary gate stay required.
